    "source": "{\"cells\":[{\"cell_type\":\"markdown\",\"metadata\":{},\"source\":\"# Validated Oracle Trajectories for the Gemma 4 Developer Agent Harness\\n\\nThis notebook generates **supervised fine-tuning (SFT) trajectories** for the competition's `swegemma` harness:\\nmulti-turn agent traces where every tool call is executed by the **real harness tools** (same prompt, same JSON\\noutputs, same truncation limits) and every trajectory is **verified by the official Phase-2 test run**.\\n\\n**How it works**\\n1. An *oracle agent* replaces the LLM inside the official `swegemma.Evaluator` (we override `_run_agent_sandbox`).\\n2. The official Phase 2 applies `test_patch` and runs pytest. A **gold control** (reference patch injected\\n   directly) tells you which tasks are resolvable in this environment at all.\\n\\n**Harness gap fixed here.** In `sandbox='subprocess'` (the only option on Kaggle without Docker),\\n`install_test_dependencies()` returns immediately, so tests run with the host Python. a, b = max(1, h[\\\"old_start\\\"] - 15), min(total, h[\\\"old_start\\\"] + max(h[\\\"old_len\\\"], 1) + 15)\\n                if windows and a \u003c= windows[-1][1] + 5:\\n
